changeLog: Version 1.3.2 - SHARE, BACKUP & RESTORE ROUTES: share any saved route with one tap from the Tracker's saved routes or the FOLLOW tab, share several at once with SELECT, or tap BACKUP ALL to send every route as a single file - to another phone over WhatsApp, Telegram, e-mail or Bluetooth, or to Drive or Files for safekeeping. On the receiving phone just open the .grroutes.json file and choose this app, or tap RESTORE. Smart restore previews what the file holds, skips routes already on the phone (even if renamed), renames a route whose name is taken, never overwrites anything, and keeps the original date, time and distance. Then tap FOLLOW NOW and be guided straight along the restored route. Route files move freely between BD MIL GR CONVERTER PRO and GR Converter Pro. Backup and restore run in the background so the app stays smooth with large route libraries. Also includes 1.3.1: the FOLLOW tab - guided checkpoint-by-checkpoint navigation along any recorded route with steering arrow, true, magnetic, mils and BD grid bearings, spoken turn cues, off-route alarm and rejoin guidance; FOLLOW and the Pro Tracker sharing one GPS engine; and a brighter, readable Night Vision mode. The instl will download the bdmgrcp file inside the itrl folder. User needs to instl that downloaded bdmgrcp.apk file from the downloaded itrl folder. As it is a BD local product, user needs to give, auth all the access, permission to instl the new version bdmgrcp.apk. This will update the present version. 17 Oct 2026.
